directive.description: takes a list of byte values which can be decimal, hex, binary or character constants and produces a table of bytes.
takes a list of word values which can be decimal or hex and produces a table of bytes where the words are arranged in low-byte hi-byte order.

takes a list of word values which can be decimal or hex and produces a table of bytes where the words are decremented by 1 and set in low-byte hi-byte order; this is useful for doing stack manipulation with e.g. return addresses.
takes a quoted string and converts it into a span of bytes. Characters are converted from ASCII to PETSCII, including any bastest token conversion.
as .text, but the span of bytes is terminated with a null (0) byte.
as .text, but the last byte has its high-bit set to 1.
as .text, but the characters are converted into screencodes.
produce 1 or more copies of a sequence of 1 or more values.
tests value or expression for inequality with zero (same as .ifne),

tests value or expression for equality with zero.
tests value or expression for positive (the condition passes if the evaluated expression is from $0 - $7fff and fails if the evaluated expression is from $8000-$ffff).
tests value or expression for negative (the condition passes if the evaluated expression is from $8000 - $ffff and fails if the evaluated expression is from $0-$7fff).
marks the end of the code block that is assembled when the conditional test is met.
tests whether a label has been defined, condition passes if it has.
tests whether a label has been defined, condition passes if it has not.
